title: BAD
body:
The fact that this app has no free trial should be a warning sign to anyone considering purchasing. I genuinely regret paying for an entire year.

• HABIT STACKING: I got pulled in by this feature, but it doesn’t really work as expected. It only works when you log a habit from within the app itself, but if you log it from your lock screen, you’ll never get the notification for your next habit.

• INCREMENTAL HABITS (e.g. drink 10 cups of water a day) not possible to decrement… are you serious?

• WIDGETS: not possible to log habits incrementally, e.g. if you have a “10 cups of water per day” tracker, you can only log all 10 cups at the same time or fail, no in-between

Despite the small number of feature, each one feels unfinished, half-baked. The entire app just feels weird to use.

Dislike.
author: Duckabilla
